newsitem.title: INDIA: Profit-taking on Reliance caps Indian stocks rally.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking on Reliance caps Indian stocks rally.

text.p: ** India shares end shade higher, early gains
capped by profit-taking in Reliance after results
** Reliance announces net profit of 13.23 billion rupees
compared to 13.05 billion, above market expectations
** Stock ends nearly unchanged, four pct below day's high
** Bombay index rises 0.84 pts at 3,800.63, off 3,839.54
** Calcutta share index up 1.11 pts at 106.26, Madras 69.53
pts at 3,702.90; Delhi down 2.64 pts to 789.90
** New Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral set to win trust
vote as parliament debates third government in 11 months
The results were sharply above the consensus estimate of 12.06 billion rupees, according to a Reuter poll.
Indian shares would trade narrowly as new Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral looked set to win a trust vote in parliament to be held later on Tuesday, analysts said.
"I think the market will take a breather," said Partha Roy Chowdhury, assistant director, equity trading, at securities firm Peregrine Capital in Hong Kong.
Analysts said the focus would now shift to key earnings of companies for the 1996/97 financial year due in the coming months.
